name: Yakusoku
source:
A once celebrated pro wrestler had lost his enthusiasm for the sport. 
Meanwhile, a young man unable to defend himself struggled with bullies. 
When these two meet, they give each other the strength to fight back and put meaning into their lives. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE123188.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位曾经著名的职业摔跤手失去了对这项运动的热情。
与此同时，一名无法自卫的年轻人与恶霸作斗争。
当这两个人相遇时，他们给予对方反击的力量，并为他们的生活赋予意义。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE123188.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
